:::{#def-measurable-function}
#### Measurable function

Let $(S, \salg)$ be a [measurable space](#def-measurable-space).
A [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) $f : S \to \reals$
is **measurable** (with respect to $\salg$)
[@wikipedia_measurable_function]
if, for every real number $c$,
the set of elements where $f$ is at most $c$ is measurable:

$$\set{s \in S : f(s) \le c} \in \salg$$

:::
